name: Yaourt phô mai
summary: Cheese yogurt, the cold finish after a plate of bánh căn. The xíu mại counters sell a plain yaourt beside the morning bowls.
origin: Yaourt phô mai at the bánh căn doors, and a yaourt beside bánh mì xíu mại.
howToEat: Have it next to a hot bowl or after the cakes.
where: Cây Bơ at 56 Tăng Bạt Hổ, Lệ at 27/44 Yersin, and the door at 7 Tăng Bạt Hổ. The xíu mại counters at 26 Hoàng Diệu and 26 Phạm Nhật Duật also sell a yaourt.
priceBand: 5,000 VND for a plain yaourt (food-tour note). Yaourt phô mai: Check on arrival.
